{{Top|leg}}
The '''Settled Worlds''' was the name given to the colonized planets of the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] during the [[Pre-Republic era]], after a number of sentients were [[Tho Yor Arrival|brought]] to the system by the [[Tho Yor]] ships. The Settled Worlds were established during the [[second migration]].

[[Shikaakwa]] served as the nexus between the Outer and Inner Settled Worlds.
